children.textContent: Possible AV is an AV company in Brooklyn, New York, with 15+ years of experience. Screens, projection, sound, light, live video, networks, interactive, fabrication and the truck that brings it, all done in house, by the same people from the first call to the strike.

children.textContent: Most projects need more than one kind of equipment, and more than one kind of person. We bring all of it, so nothing falls between suppliers.
we scope the project with you and put it in one quote
content, 3D, fabrication and custom builds made in house
our own truck, our own cases, our own crew
set up, run through the event, and struck when it is over
Booked one at a time, or all together.
Events, installs and productions across the city, delivered, set up and run by our crew.
For work outside New York, the same people travel with the equipment, for one show or a run of cities.
Three ways to work with us
Equipment with the crew to set it up, run it and take it away.
Equipment supplied and configured, and whatever we do not carry, sourced.
Systems designed, installed and handed over, with support after.

AV rental, installation and production, backed by 15+ years of experience: displays, projection, audio, lighting and staging, live video, networks, interactive, fabrication, and the logistics to bring it all.
In Brooklyn, New York. For work outside New York, the same crew travels with the equipment.
Do you make content as well as bring equipment?
Yes. Content, 3D and custom builds are made in house, alongside the equipment and the crew.
What if you do not carry something we need?
We source it and bring it in with everything else, on one quote.
LED walls are handled by our sister site,
Start with what you need and when.
Tell us where, when, how many people and what has to happen. We reply with one quote for equipment, crew and delivery.
